description:
Woo! Pumped to announce the expansion of our functional drinks range into Coles Express / Ready Express this week!

Here’s what’s now available nationally:

Hydrate + Glow: A delicious summer berry blend, packed with marine collagen and glycine for that perfect glow.

Hydrate + Focus: Tropical punch infused with L-tyrosine and B vitamins to keep you sharp and energized.

Hydrate + Revive: Bounce back faster with a blend of glutamine, B vitamins, and electrolytes—whether it's after a tough workout or a big night out!

A massive thank you to our amazing partners at Ranged Pty Ltd, led by my boys and partners in crime Jeremy Raymond and Jay Cavanagh. A huge shout-out to the Vitadrop dream team Georgie Bragg Sarah Horvat, Amy Vadiveloo and my partners and advisors Dan Concannon, Sean Gregory, Gretta van Riel, Campbell Walshe, and all our shareholders and advocates!

And a massive thank you to Sarah Dioguardi and Viva Energy Retail for backing our brand.

Just over 12 months ago, we launched into Coles and Woolies, and what a ride it’s been! We’ve navigated the highs and lows, emerging as a much stronger, more resilient business. I can’t wait to share MORE of what we’ve been quietly building in the coming weeks 👀👀👀. | 24 comments on LinkedIn
